resumen: Lying on a bench, a dumbbell held with both hands travels behind the head with the arms almost straight and comes back over the chest. It works the chest and the lats together.
ejecucion: Lie on a bench with your head supported and hold a dumbbell with both hands by the plate, over your chest.
With your elbows slightly bent and fixed, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Go down until you feel a stretch in your chest and sides, without arching your lower back.
Come back along the same arc until the dumbbell is over your chest again.
matices: It is often taught as a back exercise, but the study that measured it found more pectoralis major than latissimus dorsi activity, and a 2026 review supports this. Which one works more depends on the range and on where the load sits at each point.
